lines.text: Hi Grace, how's the heel since last time?
Since last time the first steps out of bed are still agony, but it eases after ten minutes.
Okay. Take a seat on the bed and pop your sock off. Come in!
Sorry, that's just my colleague grabbing the ultrasound gel. Hello, welcome, don't mind us.
Right, where were we. Pull your toes back towards you for me.
Ooh, I feel that right under my arch.
That's the band under your foot, it's tight right through to the heel bone, the calf is tight too.
Before you get out of bed, pull a towel round the ball of your foot and draw your toes back for thirty seconds, three times.
Wear the trainers with the thicker heel around the house rather than going barefoot.
Fair enough, the slippers are going in the bin.
Good. Same time in a fortnight.
